blind.description: A stylized fantasy wooden throne. Features a high peaked gothic-style backrest with an integrated shield emblem and dark crimson/burgundy padded upholstery. The backrest is framed by two tall pillars topped with pyramidal gold finials. The armrests slope down to front posts topped with rounded spherical finials. The seat has a matching red cushion above an ornate paneled base with carved arch details, resting on four square wooden block feet. Surfaces are clean, continuous, and solidly modeled with hand-painted stylized wood and gold trim textures.
blind.from_above: A roughly square chair profile showing the flat red seat cushion framed by two horizontal armrests with spherical caps at the front, and the pointed top backrest ridge flanked by two square pyramidal finials at the rear.
blind.height_vs_figure: Reaches approximately 4.5 to 5.0 ft high (around 80% of the 5 ft 9 in figure's height), with a width and depth of roughly 2.5 to 3 ft.
